hkbu.summary: Operational lead for two MSc programmes at HKBU Business School, orchestrating curriculum delivery, student success, and data-informed programme improvement for multinational cohorts.
hkbu.desc1: Manage end-to-end operational delivery for over 50% of core and elective courses across two MSc programmes, developing deep mastery of curriculum architecture and learning outcomes.
hkbu.desc2: Provide one-on-one academic consultation to 30+ postgraduate students annually, tailoring guidance to diverse disciplinary backgrounds and career aspirations — improving both course completion rates and programme satisfaction.
hkbu.desc3: Act as on-site technical facilitator for quantitative and coding-intensive courses, resolving real-time environment and debugging issues to maintain seamless instructional flow.
hkbu.desc4: Collect, analyse, and visualise student performance and feedback data to assist course leaders in compiling evidence-based teaching effectiveness reports. Leverage programme knowledge to counsel prospective applicants on career-market fit, enhancing pre-enrolment engagement.

chaos.summary: Built automated performance analytics pipelines for a commodity futures firm, transforming raw trading data into actionable trader metrics and visual dashboards.
chaos.desc1: Designed and maintained a weekly data pipeline using Python and SQL to process trading account data, constructing key performance indicators — P&L ratios, win rates, trading volumes — for firm-wide review.
chaos.desc2: Developed reusable Tableau dashboard templates that visualised trading behaviour patterns across multiple commodity futures products, enabling consistent cross-product performance comparison.
chaos.desc3: Automated the extraction and structured delivery of client trading datasets to support weekly performance reviews, eliminating manual data wrangling.

changjiang.summary: Automated financial market data ingestion and built investment research dashboards at a major futures brokerage, supporting daily analyst workflows.
changjiang.desc1: Engineered Python-based data automation scripts (Pandas) to extract market data from the Wind API and load it into MySQL, replacing manual data collection with a reliable scheduled pipeline.
changjiang.desc2: Designed and maintained interactive data visualisation dashboards to track sector-level trends, directly supporting the investment research team's daily decision-making.
changjiang.desc3: Authored a full cycle of periodic analytical reports — daily briefs, weekly summaries, and monthly deep-dives — synthesising quantitative findings into concise narratives for the investment team.

boc.summary: Contributed to a Digital Campus transformation project with Central China Normal University, establishing data infrastructure and applying NLP to student feedback at scale.
boc.desc1: Supported the Digital Campus Development initiative by collecting and standardising fragmented offline institutional data (e.g. fixed-asset records), designing MySQL database schemas for centralised, real-time access.
boc.desc2: Conducted Python-based natural language processing on semester-long student course evaluations — generating word-frequency visualisations that surfaced thematic insights for faculty and departmental review.
boc.desc3: Collaborated across university and banking technology teams to bridge academic needs with fintech solutions, gaining early exposure to the intersection of education and financial technology.
